name: space-research
description: Bounded primary-source research for the public Space graph; stages candidates for independent curator review and never publishes.

steps.name: read-published-subjects
steps.description: Read the current public corpus version and bounded neighbourhood through signed Tower routes.
steps.prompt: Run bun clis/space-research.ts subjects --ids <comma-separated subjectIds> using the brokered capability and the configured PIPELINE_TOWER_URL. Only one or two IDs are permitted. Return its JSON object exactly: graphVersion, topics and existingPrerequisites. Do not use keys, owner identity overrides, learner records or chat content. If the CLI fails, report the error so the step fails.

steps.name: bound-topic-selection
steps.description: Limit each run to two published topics, one hop and three proposed concepts.

steps.name: propose-supporting-concepts
steps.description: Propose useful gaps and at most three primary URLs for the selected published topics.
steps.prompt: For the selected Space concepts, propose up to three useful supporting concepts at depth one. Research primary publisher URLs (NASA or ESA) that could substantiate them. Return JSON only: {concepts:[{id,title,subjectId,reason}],sources:[{url,reason}]}. Use stable kebab-case IDs. Do not claim source content you have not read. No learner data or chat output.

steps.name: validate-source-plan
steps.description: Reject excess fanout, unknown subjects and non-primary or duplicate source URLs.

steps.name: retrieve-primary-sources
steps.description: Fetch at most three allowlisted primary pages with bounded response text.

steps.name: extract-claims-and-links
steps.description: Extract short claims, typed concept links and exact source excerpts with section locators.
steps.prompt: Use only the supplied retrieved primary-source text. Return JSON only: {sources:[{url,title,publisher}],concepts:[{id,cluster,title,claim}],relations:[{from,to,type}],supports:[{targetType,targetId,sourceUrl,locator,excerpt,summary}]}. Use only proposed concept IDs and selected subject IDs. Type is prerequisite, supports, explains or related. A relation ID is from--to--type. Every new concept and relation needs its own support; excerpt must be an exact contiguous passage of at least 20 characters in the retrieved text, locator a named section, and summary a short paraphrase. Reject unsupported facts by omitting them. Never use learner data.

steps.name: validate-citations-and-cycles
steps.description: Require exact retrieved excerpts, locators and support for every claim and link; reject prerequisite cycles.

steps.name: stage-candidate
steps.description: Stage the validated addition with a signed curator capability; return only its candidate ID and status.
steps.prompt: Write the exact candidate input JSON to an ignored file under tmp/docs/handoffs after verifying git check-ignore. Run bun clis/space-research.ts stage --file <that-file> through the brokered agent capability and configured PIPELINE_TOWER_URL. Return the CLI JSON exactly: candidateId, reviewStatus, idempotent, issues. Do not call review or publish routes. Do not use keys, owner overrides or learner records. Any CLI error must fail this step.

steps.name: independent-review-gate
steps.description: Stop after staging; an independent curator must review and publish outside this pipeline.
